verdict.rationale: Square documents an official MCP server. It offers a hosted remote endpoint at mcp.squareup.com/mcp with OAuth login and granular scopes, plus a local `npx square-mcp-server start` mode with sandbox and read-only controls. The docs include setup guides for Claude, Cursor, Goose and Windsurf, and a probe confirmed the docs page exists. Missing for 10: GA status (the GitHub server is labeled Beta), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually connecting.
